name: Triple Royal Gold
review:
A cabinet-style game on a 3x3 grid with up to 27 ways, wilds and avalanches. Collect the letters B-O-N-U-S to trigger the bonus, where the multiplier can reach 27x.

Spelling out BONUS gives you a nice sense of progress, even on dry runs. Very high volatility, 5,000x cap, 96.41% RTP. A retro look with modern maths behind it.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
